query: Which privacy-preserving linkage approach (secure hashing, secure multi-party computation, synthetic data, or differential privacy) will we commit to for household linkage, and what synthetic/aggregated outputs will replace direct linkage if unavailable?

response.query: Which privacy-preserving linkage approach (secure hashing, secure multi-party computation, synthetic data, or differential privacy) will we commit to for household linkage, and what synthetic/aggregated outputs will replace direct linkage if unavailable?
response.answer: For household linkage, we commit to differential privacy. Synthetic/aggregated outputs will replace direct linkage if unavailable.
